decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a mix of budget, mid-range, and premium speakers. The consideration set includes a very high-value budget option (EDUPLINK), a solid mid-range performer (comiso), a trusted refurbished brand name (JBL), and two high-end audio choices (Bose and Bang & Olufsen). Ultimately, the EDUPLINK (prod_bluetooth_speakers_051) was selected because its 4.5 rating over 9,100 reviews suggests high reliability and performance at a very accessible price point, offering the best ratio of features to cost.
